media.observations: Six panels and alpha line/marker identities readable; close R/q/distance curves overlap at this whole-path scale. Legends occupy plot interiors and two-significant-digit ticks are rounded; exact 23-field values and differences are in JSON/tables. No equality or alpha-independence inferred from overlap.

Origin and accepted peak identities correct, full structure uses visual symmetry and actual x1; lower-half equal-aspect tip closeups show fixed raster body and approaching tip; analytic circle is reference. The micrometre peak distance is numerically annotated, not independently resolvable as a width at full-view pixels.
Unsigned distance and signed Fx/Fy panels readable; negative Fx retained, total/material/Hu distinct. Two distance curves coincide visually; individual small differences require saved raw rows.

Four x1 lower-half fields, units and colorbars visible. Plots show solid/nonbody-medium cell summaries and Hu Frobenius, not the global nine-point minimum J or maximum absolute Hu component; narrow extreme cells are not individually resolved in the whole-domain view.

Six panels readable with mesh/reference/free-edge identities, separate J/Hu/Green scales and full480-cell histories. Maps explicitly crop y27..41; extrema/witness labels cover the full strip. This does not demonstrate domain-width convergence or absence of boundary effects.

Chronological checks, accepted diagnostics, constraint bounds and counts readable. Symlog preserves zeros; very small constraint values cluster visually near zero and exact values remain in JSON. Dashed accepted-panel tolerance is the residual tolerance; original global-balance gate is separately retained in protocol/helper.
